description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Base Attack Bonus of +1, Weapon Focus with a single one-handed or two handed weapon

Benefit: When assuming this style, you must be wielding a one-handed or two handed melee weapon that weighs 5 pounds or more and must be the selected weapon of Weapon Focus. Every time you miss a melee attack roll, you get a +1 Competence bonus to your next attack roll until the end of your next turn (stacks up to +5). In addition, you can add the base weight of your weapon as a circumstance bonus to your CMD against Bull Rush, Trip, and Overrun maneuvers. You cannot gain these benefits with two weapon fighting.

system.requirements: Base Attack Bonus of +1, Weapon Focus with a single one-handed or two handed weapon
